overview: Ssraeshza Temple is the heart of Shissar power on Luclin.
history: The Shissar fled Norrath to escape the Greenmist, building a new empire on Luclin. Ssraeshza Temple is their greatest achievement: a divine fortress, a ritual nexus, and the seat of the Emperor. Cursed magic permeates every hall.
hooks: A cursed ritual destabilizes the temple’s wards.
Imperial guards mobilize for a purge of intruders.
Undead Shissar awaken in the Cursed Halls.
The Emperor’s Chamber pulses with divine energy.
